title: Preserve SEO parity via extraction + layout rendering
decision: SEO metadata is extracted from the source snapshot into src/lib/content/seo.ts and rendered centrally in src/routes/+layout.svelte to preserve old-to-new parity.
context: Migration needed parity for title, description, canonical, OG/Twitter tags, and structured data while moving to static Svelte output.
implementation: scripts/migrate-snapshot.mjs extracts SEO fields into seo.ts.
src/routes/+layout.svelte emits all relevant meta/link/script tags from seo.ts.
tests/e2e/home.spec.ts asserts core SEO metadata is present.
consequences: Single source for SEO metadata with reproducible regeneration.
Lower chance of metadata drift across routes.
